title: MenuItemUpdated
description: A menu item was created or changed. Carries the full descriptive state of the item (event-carried state transfer), so Conversation upserts its menu_projection row and recomputes the embedding (SAD 8.3). Availability is not part of this event; it travels in MenuItemAvailabilityChanged. Routing key: catalog.menu_item_updated.

aliases.description: Alternative and colloquial names. Empty array when there are none.

description.description: Ingredients and notes. Empty string when there is none.

price.description: List price in Toman. Display only (menu_projection.display_price); the amount of an order always comes from Order (SAD 8.3).

category.description: Category name as shown to customers.

complements.description: Complement rules of this item (SAD 8.3: published with the item). Empty array when there are none.
